title: Urbex palette (version 2)
description: A version 2 palette asset (data/<namespace>/urbex/palettes/<name>.json) or a definitions asset, as MODEL.001 through MODEL.005 in docs/format/palette/00-model.md define it. The node model - MODEL.010's five positions a node appears in - is expressed as one recursive '$defs/node', referenced by every position a node can occupy: a marker's value, a '$defs' value, a 'choices' entry, a socket candidate, and a block-valued trait field. What this schema cannot check is anything that needs another document, a registry, or arithmetic across sibling choices - REF.013's dangling $ref, WEIGHT.014's share totals, TRAIT.021's pool lookup and the rest are refused by the loader, not here; see PaletteSchemaTest for exactly which REJECT fixtures this schema is expected to catch.

version.description: MODEL.002: a palette file with no 'version' is version 1, and any value other than 1 or 2 is refused. This schema describes the version 2 shape alone, so it fixes the value rather than leaving it an integer.

extends.description: MERGE.001: the one palette this file builds on, fully qualified.

$imports.description: REF.080: an alias name to a pointer prefix, expanded textually wherever '$<name>' is written.

propertyNames.description: REF.082: '$super' is a built-in alias and may not be declared in '$imports'.

$defs.description: REF.001: a definition name to a node. REF.020, MODEL.082: a definition need not resolve to a block source, so this is the one position that stays partial - 'nodeOrBlock', not 'nodeOrBlockComplete'.

palette.description: MODEL.003: a marker to a node. Required somewhere in the 'extends' chain, not in every file - so this key is optional here. MODEL.081: a marker position must resolve to a block source, so this is 'nodeOrBlockComplete'.

qualifiedIdentifier.description: A datapack asset reference. The namespace is mandatory.

when.description: WEIGHT.020 through WEIGHT.023: a load-time condition on one alternative.

mod.description: WEIGHT.023: a mod id that must be loaded.

pack.description: WEIGHT.023: a namespace that must register assets.

node.description: MODEL.010: the single value type of the format, in all five positions it may appear. Deliberately not closed here - additionalProperties/unevaluatedProperties is applied at each usage site ('nodeOrBlock', 'choice'), because a node's closed key set differs from a choice's by exactly RawChoice.OWN_KEYS, and one open definition lets both close over it rather than needing two copies of the same property list.

kind.description: MODEL.012: a kind outside these five values is refused. MODEL.011: absent, a node has kind 'block'.

block.description: MODEL.040, MODEL.041: a block id, optionally followed by a bracketed property expression.

choices.description: MODEL.044: the alternatives of a 'weighted' node. MODEL.045: empty is refused.

tag.description: MODEL.050, MODEL.051: a block tag reference with a leading '#' and a namespace.

of.description: MODEL.060, MODEL.061: the marker an 'alias' node resolves through - exactly one character (CHAR.001), which this schema cannot check without risking a false rejection of an astral-plane marker; see PaletteSchemaTest's note.

floor.description: MODEL.071: one of a 'light_socket' node's four placement lists.

wall.description: MODEL.071: one of a 'light_socket' node's four placement lists.

ceiling.description: MODEL.071: one of a 'light_socket' node's four placement lists.

free.description: MODEL.071: one of a 'light_socket' node's four placement lists.

$ref.description: REF.002: a pointer naming the definition this node is based on.

$only.description: REF.051, REF.054: the top-level keys of the target a '$ref' contributes. REF.055: a name that is not a key of a node is refused.

$without.description: REF.052, REF.054: the top-level keys of the target a '$ref' does not contribute.

$spread.description: REF.070: a pointer to the list this element is replaced by.

allOf.description: MODEL.013: a kind's specific keys are not accepted on another - 'block' accepts only 'block' among the five kind-specific keys.
MODEL.013: 'weighted' accepts only 'choices' among the five kind-specific keys.
MODEL.013: 'tag' accepts only 'tag' among the five kind-specific keys.
MODEL.013: 'alias' accepts only 'of' among the five kind-specific keys.
MODEL.013: 'light_socket' accepts only its four placement lists among the five kind-specific keys.
MODEL.072: a 'light_socket' declaring no candidate in any of the four lists is refused, unless it takes its lists from a '$ref' this node cannot see.
MODEL.011: absent 'kind' and absent '$ref' defaults to kind 'block' - the referenced node's kind is not knowable here, so only that case is restricted.
REF.056: '$only' or '$without' on a node with no '$ref' is refused - a filter selects the keys a reference contributes, and one with none has nothing to select from.
REF.053: a node carrying both '$only' and '$without' is refused.

nodeOrBlock.description: MODEL.020: wherever a node is expected, a JSON string is that node with kind 'block' and that string as its 'block'. MODEL.021: a string is never a reference - the object form is required to name one. Partial: see 'completeNode' for the four positions MODEL.081 holds to a stricter standard.

completeNode.description: MODEL.081: a node in a marker position, a 'choices' entry, a socket candidate or a block-valued trait field must have a 'kind' and that kind's required keys, once references are resolved - MODEL.040 ('block'), MODEL.044 ('choices'), MODEL.050 ('tag'), MODEL.060 ('of'). 'light_socket' needs nothing further here: MODEL.072 already requires a candidate in 'node' itself, unconditionally of position. This schema cannot resolve a '$ref' or a '$spread', so each requirement is skipped when either is present - REF.021 makes that completeness a fact about the resolved node, checked where the reference resolves, which is outside what a static schema can reach; a '$spread' element carries no key of its own to begin with (REF.072). '$defs/node' stays partial on its own (REF.020, MODEL.082): this schema adds the requirement only at the four positions that need it, over 'node' rather than instead of it.

allOf.description: MODEL.040: a 'block' node's (or a node with no 'kind', MODEL.011's default) required field is 'block'.
MODEL.044: a 'weighted' node's required field is 'choices'.
MODEL.050: a 'tag' node's required field is 'tag'.
MODEL.060: an 'alias' node's required field is 'of'.

nodeOrBlockComplete.description: MODEL.020, MODEL.081: the node a marker's value, a 'choices' entry or a socket candidate must be - a string, or an object that resolves to a block source.

satelliteNode.description: MODEL.081, MODEL.033: a satellite must resolve to a block source like any other node - so this builds on 'nodeOrBlockComplete' - but with one restriction beyond it: kind 'light_socket' is forbidden here, because a socket defers placement to search for a support and orient itself, and a satellite is written at a position already decided (MODEL.033's own words). Composed as one extra 'not' clause over 'nodeOrBlockComplete' rather than a second copy of the node shape, which is what the recursive '$defs/node' this schema is built around is for.

choice.description: MODEL.046, MODEL.071: an entry in 'choices' or in a 'light_socket' placement list - a node carrying additionally 'share', 'weight' or 'rest', and optionally 'when'. A bare '$spread' element carries no other key (REF.072) and so states no size (REF.070). MODEL.081: both kinds of list hold a 'completeNode', not a bare 'node' - a choice or a candidate must resolve to a block source.

share.description: WEIGHT.004, WEIGHT.010: a fraction strictly between 0 and 1.

rest.description: WEIGHT.012: 'rest: true' is the sole 'weight' choice written without a number.

sizedList.description: WEIGHT.001: one spelling of size, wherever a list of alternatives appears. WEIGHT.013: more than one 'rest' in a list is refused, and so is a 'rest' in a list that also carries a 'weight'.

traits.description: TRAIT.001: an object mapping a trait id to that trait's value. Only the seven traits this specification defines have a known shape here - TRAIT.090 makes traits the format's extension point, so an id this schema does not recognise is left open rather than refused; TRAIT.003's refusal of an unregistered id is a registry lookup, not a shape this schema can check. TRAIT.064: a node carrying two traits of the selection phase - today, 'urbex:light' and 'urbex:optional' - is refused.

traitDamaged.description: TRAIT.010: 'urbex:damaged' - what this node's block becomes where the damage pass applies.

traitLoot.description: TRAIT.020: 'urbex:loot' - this node's block is a loot container. 'pool' names a 'conditions' asset whose values are loot tables.

traitSpawner.description: TRAIT.030: 'urbex:spawner' - this node's block is initialised as a mob spawner. 'pool' names a 'conditions' asset whose values are entity ids.

traitBlockEntity.description: TRAIT.040: 'urbex:block_entity' - the NBT a block entity is initialised with. TRAIT.042: the positional keys 'x', 'y', 'z' and the type key 'id' are accepted here and dropped with a warning, not refused - so this schema does not exclude them.

traitLight.description: TRAIT.050: 'urbex:light' - this node's block is an optional light. TRAIT.051: an absent 'unlit' is air, so it is not required here.

traitOptional.description: TRAIT.060: 'urbex:optional' - this node is placed only when a named density roll accepts it. TRAIT.062: an absent 'replacement' is air, so it is not required here.

density.description: TRAIT.061: names a density in the preset's decoration settings.

traitRotatable.description: TRAIT.070 through TRAIT.072: 'urbex:rotatable' is the one trait with a scalar shorthand - its whole content is one boolean, and there are no keys to name.
